method: Codex agent assessment using the locked definition and all 44 reference judgments; not a Decisions API run
dateLimitations: Last screening is day-precision Oct 27 Pacific; Ashby dates are last-published and may include reposts. Greenhouse dates are first_published, never updated_at.
scope: Complete 10-role U.S.-eligible set in the after-cutoff window from 20 selected employer boards; not the entire U.S. market.

records.title: Associate GTM Engineer
records.reason: Personally builds and ships AI workflows, supports requirements, rolls them out, and measures business results. Ownership is supervised rather than autonomous; that is the main boundary to review.
evidence: 2+ years in RevOps, GTM strategy, sales

records.title: Sales Operations Manager
records.location: San Francisco, CA • New York, NY
records.reason: Owns operational improvements and builds AI-enabled intelligence systems; hands-on Claude Code/Codex is explicitly requested. Distinguish this from analysis-only sales operations.
evidence: including hands-on experience with Claude Code and Codex

records.title: Staff Product Designer, Activation
records.reason: Owns design strategy and shipped experiences, but coding/AI prototyping appears as a supporting qualification, not a central mandate to personally build working software.
evidence: Comfort prototyping in code or with AI tools

records.title: Deployment Strategist, National Security
records.reason: Customer adoption, training, renewals, and expansion are the core accountabilities. AI fluency and product feedback do not establish personal software building.
evidence: own a portfolio of U.S. defense and intelligence accounts

records.title: B2B Lifecycle Marketing Manager
records.reason: Personally builds lifecycle campaigns and owns their outcomes, but the posting does not make AI-assisted software/tools/agents creation central. Marketing automation alone is insufficient.
evidence: 3+ years hands-on with a lifecycle platform

records.title: Manager, Software Engineering - UX Platform
records.location: San Francisco, CA • New York, NY • United States
records.reason: Leads an engineering team and its roadmap; the individual is not hired primarily to personally build and ship with AI.
evidence: Manage and support a team of experienced engineers

records.title: PhD Intern, Security Engineer (2027)
records.location: San Francisco, CA • New York, NY
records.reason: Direct engineering work is present, but AI coding tools are an optional plus rather than central to this security internship. This is not rejected merely for engineering qualifications.
evidence: Proficiency in at least one general-purpose coding language

records.title: Enablement Manager, Public Sector
records.location: United States; London, United Kingdom; EMEA
records.reason: Sales enablement, onboarding, training, and content systems are central; no personal AI-software-building mandate.

records.title: Head of Communications
records.reason: Communications strategy, PR, and executive visibility; no personal AI-assisted software-building mandate.
evidence: Develop and implement a comprehensive communications strategy

records.title: Warehouse Associate II, Ground Operations
records.reason: Physical warehouse operations, package sorting, and driver launches; no software builder mandate.
evidence: scan, sort packages onto pallets or into routes
